newsitem.title: CROATIA: BASKETBALL-ZAGREB HANG ON FOR DRAMATIC VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-ZAGREB HANG ON FOR DRAMATIC VICTORY.

text.p: Cibona Zagreb hung on for a dramatic 63-61 victory over Olympiakos of Greece in their group B EuroLeague basketball clash on Thursday.
In the closing seconds Mate Skelin came on from the substitutes bench just in time to make an all important block as the Greeks pressed for victory.
It was a fitting result for Cibona marking their 250th appearance in European championship games since they first made the grade 22 years ago.
The victory greatly enhanced their chances of a top three slot and an easier second phase schedule.
